findings.issue: OVER-CLOSURE ATTACK (primary), adjudicated ACCEPTABLE fail-closed, NOT blocking. Before T-0723, in a PDP-WIRED deployment a NON-participant tenant member could see a record-less instance in LIST + open its DETAIL (the unconditional `true`/keep). After the flip only a participant (acted / holds an addressed task role / tenant owner=clause 3) sees it; a non-participant 'glance-only' colleague no longer does. This is NOT a regression of legitimate work because: (1) blast radius is EXACTLY the two callers — GET /api/processes (LIST) and GET /api/processes/:id (DETAIL); each flipped function has precisely ONE caller (verified). (2) The T-0742 catalog counters read listInstanceProjections DIRECTLY (process-catalog.ts:344), BYPASSING filterProjectionsByReadVisibility, so the flip cannot change any catalog/analytics count — verified by caller map. (3) Record-BOUND instances (the create=start norm) were ALREADY READ-PDP-gated by T-0721/T-0722; a non-participant colleague already could not see them, so the pre-flip blanket-openness made record-LESS instances MORE visible than record-bound — an accidental asymmetry the spec correctly calls a 'papered-over gap' (unconditional true), not a designed capability. (4) Record-less instances are created ONLY via /api/processes/start explicit-launch, which has ZERO web UI callers (grep web/ = 0) → an API-only edge, not a normal flow. (5) The legitimate participant (starter/addressed-role/owner) stays fully visible (DETAIL skeleton + LIST presence, db-proven); the 'boss' is the owner (clause 3). (6) Honest-degrade (resolver unwired) is byte-identical to pre-T-0721 — the flip only bites where record-bound is already gated, keeping a consistent posture. Contrast with FF-INST-VIS-4 (T-0722): that narrowed WITHIN tenant scope without breaking work; this closes a blanket-open default down to the SAME participant floor T-0756 already established as legitimate-work-preserving.
findings.suggestion: No action required — this is the intended fail-closed hardening. If any real deployment ever depended on colleagues browsing all record-less instances, that would be a process-definition-scoped read grant (T-0714 §5 phase-3, explicitly deferred), not a reason to keep blanket-open.
